title: Regulating AI 'not the right place to start' says Bailey
summary: Bank of England Governor Andrew Bailey says that regulating AI is not the right starting point, emphasizing the need for rigorous testing and safeguards to manage AI risks.

title: Best AI Tools for Photographers in 2026
summary: The article reviews the most effective AI-powered applications available to photographers in 2026, covering tools for image editing, organization, and creative enhancement. It highlights how these solutions streamline workflow, improve productivity, and enable new artistic possibilities for both amateurs and professionals.

title: Practical Secrets Extraction against Black-box LLMs
summary: The paper introduces a black‑box framework for extracting confidential credentials that large language models may have memorized, even when only output responses are accessible via commercial APIs. By distilling secret‑related behavior into a local proxy and employing guided sampling with entropy and structural priors, the method outperforms prior baselines and demonstrates real‑world extraction of masked provider credentials from OpenAI and Claude Code systems.
